{{Otheruses|Security Chief}}
The '''Security Chief's Seconds''' were the assistants of the [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]], or [[Constable/Legends|constable]], of the city of [[Bartyn's Landing]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. The Chief could chose his Seconds among citizens whom he trusted. Like the Chief, the Seconds were employees of the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]],<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> and wore an ORO insignia.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

C. [[69 BBY/Legends|69 BBY]], Chief [[Ertine]] and most of his Seconds died in a trap of [[Byrch Dyshkava]]. The only surviving Second, [[Mix Liddell]], was appointed the new Chief. Liddell recruited several Seconds, including his friend [[Grubber Vapps]], and they stopped Dyshkava. In time, Vapps was promoted to Senior Second.<ref name="BL" />

C. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], Liddell believed that most of his Seconds were accepting bribes from [[Administrator (ORO)|Administrator]] [[Guther Bartyn]]; he still trusted Vapps and Second [[Boom Boom]]. Due to his position, he tried to hire some new Seconds.<ref name="R" />
